story.fullStory:
Ziggy Marley's "Live Jam" — original release 1977. "Jamming" is a song by the reggae band Bob Marley and the Wailers from their 1977 album Exodus.

Artist: Ziggy Marley · Title: Live Jam · Year: 1998 · Genre: Reggae · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/1990's/Ziggy Marley - Live Jam.mp4.

The song also appears on the compilation album Legend.

The song was re-released 10 years later as a tribute to Bob Marley and was again a hit, as in the Netherlands, where it was classified in the charts for 4 weeks.
